**What this changes, and why.**

**How it was verified.** Which commands you ran, and what they said. `pnpm check`
is the usual answer; if a test is the point of the change, say what happens when
the fix is removed — a test that passes against unfixed code proves nothing.

**Anything you decided not to do**, and why it is out of scope here.
